sentences.en: There are people you have to watch through the beer goggles.
sentences.zh: 你得通过啤酒蒙眬的眼来看某些人。

sentences.en: Water is leaking into my goggles. I don't think they fit right.
sentences.zh: 水渗进了我的游泳镜里。我觉得它们可能不太合适。

sentences.en: The goggles protect your eyes from dust.
sentences.zh: 游泳镜能保护眼睛不受灰尘的侵害。

senses.zh: [安全] 护目镜；防护眼镜；瞪视（goggle的复数）
瞪大眼睛看；转动眼珠（goggle的三单形式）
